title: Lobster, Paladin Named to Women In Leadership Cohort
summary_en: Two members of the Saint Louis University community have been named to the FOCUS St. Louis Women In Leadership. LySyin Lobster, operations coordinator for Habitat for Neighborhood Business (SLU-HNB) in the Richard A. Chaifetz School of Business, and Kelly Paladin, assistant director of communication in the Office of Admission, were two of the 27 women named to the fall 2026 cohort.
